en.gui.eclipse.skills.footer_hint: Select a node to see details — double-click to unlock it. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, TAB switches tabs.
en.gui.eclipse.skills.state.confirm: Costly node — buy again to confirm
en.gui.eclipse.skills.rebirth.warning: Resets skills & levels — grants +1 life. Hold to confirm.
en.gui.eclipse.skills.wand.none_hint: Craft the Veil Wand to open this path.

en.gui.eclipse.skills.wand.cycle_hint: Sneak + right-click cycles the selected power.
